clips.title: The story
paras: Gregor's Remains are the physical bones recovered from the Scourge-enslaved Gregor Agamand. Once part of the wealthiest dynasty in Tirisfal Glades, his remains are sought by a former mill worker eager to settle an old score from beyond the grave.

Before the Third War, the Agamand family held immense wealth and vast tracts of land across northern Tirisfal Glades. When the Scourge invaded Lordaeron, the patriarchs chose pride over flight, fortifying their family mills and persuading their loyal laborers to make a desperate stand against the undead. The defense failed entirely. The estate was overrun, and those who stood their ground were butchered and raised into undeath. Gregor Agamand became another mindless thrall in the service of the Lich King, haunting the very mills his family once ruled.

For survivors who broke free from the Lich King's grip to join the Forsaken, the memory of that fateful defense remains a bitter wound. Coleman Farthing, a former mill worker stationed in Brill, blames the hubris of the Agamands for trapping his soul in eternal rot. Collecting Gregor's remains offers Farthing a measure of personal retribution, closing the chapter on a master who led his household straight into damnation.
